description: Use this skill when the user wants help with pricing decisions, packaging, or monetization strategy. Trigger on: figuring out what to charge, how to structure pricing tiers (good-better-best), choosing value metrics (per seat, usage-based, flat fee), freemium vs free trial decisions, pricing research methods (Van Westendorp, willingness to pay), raising prices, annual vs monthly billing, or tier differentiation. This skill focuses on strategic pricing decisions—what to charge and how to package it. For pricing page design/CRO, use page-cro. For pricing page copywriting, use copywriting.
